name: atseq-native-v1

wire.cid: CIDv1 dag-cbor sha2-256 canonical lower-case base32
wire.rawCid: CIDv1 raw sha2-256 canonical lower-case base32
wire.bytes: canonical unpadded base64; exact trailing bits

paths.entryKey: full genesis CID followed by dot and exactly 16 decimal position digits
paths.grantAndRevokeKey: 26-character lower-case base32 16-byte grant ID with exact trailing bits
paths.entryPositions: contiguous positive safe integers; predecessor of position one is genesis

signatures.subject: exact complete unsigned intent canonical CBOR
signatures.repositoryKeys: maintained controller extraction; require canonical normalized did:key; native commit signature and DID required

lookupOrder: exact unsigned request CID and original recorded result
retry.nonce: 16 cryptographically random bytes supplied before signing
retry.unsignedIdentity: complete canonical unsigned intent; first retained signature is original
retry.orderedDuplicates: duplicate request CID, actor retry tuple or consumed observation CID is invalid history
retry.replacement: no automatic resigning, nonce replacement, retargeting or re-observation of exact retries

publication.root: one authenticated selected native repository commit
publication.required: exact genesis/head/entry paths and CIDs under selected root; actor signatures and explicit app chain
publication.absence: proved absence of a claimed required record is invalid; a missing proof block is unavailable
publication.mutation: PDS can withhold, delete, fork and reorder valid signed work; no global non-equivocation or latestness
publication.receipt: native membership and retained key binding prove publication, not interpretation
publication.appBinding: retained outside containing root; cannot appoint its own initial trust

observation.policy: immutable genesis-appointed closed observation policy; supported algorithm atseq-account-observation-v1 and checkpoint native-publication-v1; configured PLC directory and allowWeb are explicit retained policy data
observation.plc: verify canonical complete retained operation history, genesis derivation, authorized transitions and computed last tip; untrusted selected-tip hints do not select an older branch
observation.web: exact strict retained DID JSON and maintained hostname mapping; app publication does not prove domain control/currentness
observation.binding: before and after method observations must agree in tip/document, signing key and PDS; extracted key equals the selected commit key
observation.subject: exact omitted-observation operation projection bound to app/genesis/position/predecessor and operation; recovery omits its observation field and actor signature from this subject
observation.records: closed exact required subject path/CID set; no unrelated records
observation.epochChain: current pointer and required predecessor chain to accepted expected anchor; initial import/recovery needs selected current transition
observation.consumption: each authenticated descriptor is consumed once, including ineffective operations
observation.availability: missing retained bytes, operational evidence limits or unprocessable proof budgets stall; fully supplied contradictions are invalid history
observation.assurance: native publication asserts observation currentness; stale authentic PLC evidence and fabricated web principal evidence remain custody limitations

initial.roles: enabled assignments use genesis CID; absent assignment revision is null

authority.grant: one exact previously admitted immutable grant CID/body; no grant union; account grant deletion is not revocation
authority.revocation: terminal grant-ID tombstone even before admission
authority.epoch: accepted epoch CIDs and IDs remain retired forever; copied backups cannot restore grants
authority.normalFloor: reject lower revision or equal revision/different root; otherwise advance floor before delegated stale/no-op checks
authority.recoveryFloor: only prior appointed recovery plus exact expected floor/epoch may accept a never-accepted epoch/ID and replace floor; failed recovery consumes descriptor without changing floor/epoch
authority.role: one referenced live grant plus owner and grant assignRoles scope for assignRole; govern setRole needs no participant grant; only effective changes replace revision with unsigned request CID
authority.controlContext: check intended position/predecessor, control tip, prior appointment then required power
authority.setControl: govern; preserve every recover pair and its entire powers exactly; no new recover pair
authority.setRecovery: recover; nonempty selected pairs replace only recover bits, preserve all lower bits and drop empty pairs
authority.recoverGovernance: recover and immutable genesis flag; selected pairs replace only govern bits, preserve certify/recover
authority.capacityFailure: resulting merged map above 16 is control_map_limit; no quorum or escape manufacture
authority.singleRecoveryRisk: one recovery signer can replace honest peers; recover-only pairs avoid some capacity traps
authority.controlTip: advance only on effective control operation; account operations and owner grant role changes do not advance it
authority.commit: authenticated valid ineffective entries still consume request/retry/descriptor identities and advance frontier; throws leave prior accepted authority unchanged
authority.expectation: expected epoch/observation are compared with complete prior row before normalFloor advances; stale normal operations may retain the new accepted observation floor

setControl: control_power for changed or new recover pair

invalidHistory: operation context or observation subject substitution

projection: opaque accepted authority; owned sorted JSON snapshots are data, never accepted-state constructors; no caller trust flag, eligibility callback, checkpoint parser or archive JSON can mint authority

normal: if selected current CID equals prior accepted current CID, no epoch change
candidate CID or ID already accepted: epoch_reused
non-null prior current not equal final predecessor: epoch_conflict
retain every newly accepted CID/ID/predecessor and select current
recovery: any selected candidate CID/ID already accepted: recovery_epoch_reused
accept fresh current, retain old epoch history and terminal grant revocations; no prior predecessor requirement
epochProgression.admitGrant: after grant scope/revoke/immutable CID checks, mismatching grant epoch versus selected pointer is epoch_conflict before normal progression; existing same CID then authority_unchanged
epochProgression.advanceEpoch: run normal progression then authority_unchanged if prior and next current epoch equal
